phase: Phase B: Topological Graph & Routing Integration
reasons: Directed road graph successfully constructed with 40 nodes, 44 directed edges, and 18 components.
Risk-aware topological Dijkstra pathfinder correctly enforces hard avoidance of verified impassable roads.
Demonstration routes correctly surface uncertainty warnings and strictly prohibit forbidden safety phrasing.
Metropolitan routing remains constrained by sparse seed catalog (22 segments, ~25.64 km); citywide routing BLOCKED pending authorized OSM bulk ingestion.
Production authorization remains BLOCKED pending server-side cryptographic authentication provider.

disconnected_seed_pair.warning: Origin node 'NODE-OU-COLONY' and destination node 'NODE-PATNY-CIRCLE' belong to disconnected topological components. No continuous road network path exists between them.

test_graph_verified_impassable_detour.exclusion_explanation: Segment TEST-SEG-2 (Tolichowki Flyover Underpass) was pruned: Verified impassable flood inundation.

data_sources_and_licensing.seed_catalog_source: Sahaay AI Curated Hyderabad Inundation Vulnerability Corridors
data_sources_and_licensing.attribution_compliance: Explicit OpenStreetMap attribution required in map symbology and metadata

authentication_security.finding: Map refresh endpoint (POST /api/v1/map/corridors/refresh) trusts caller-supplied JSON role payload.
authentication_security.vulnerability_analysis: No server-side cryptographic signature, JWT validator, or session authority verifies the caller's role.
secure_integration_path: 1. Implement RFC 7519 JWT / OAuth2 Bearer token authentication via FastAPI HTTPBearer / Security dependency.
2. Integrate municipal SSO / Identity Provider (Keycloak / Auth0 / Supabase / OIDC).
3. Server-side signature verification against IdP public key (JWKS) before evaluating role claims.
4. Eliminate all caller-supplied role strings from request body schemas.
authentication_security.approval_required: Introduction of a cryptographic auth provider requires administrative approval.

remaining_blockers: Network coverage gap: Only 22 discrete corridors (~25.64 km) exist in the seed catalog across 18 disconnected components.
Citywide routing blocked: Production routing requires bulk ingestion of an authorized OSM extract covering the entire Hyderabad metropolitan area (EPSG:4326).
Authentication blocked: Production administrative and dispatcher actions require integration of a server-side cryptographic Identity Provider.
Live sensor telemetry: Dynamic road-status updates currently rely on mock snapshots; physical IoT flood gauges and DRF field responder telemetry must be integrated.
